items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: I was offered a job there with me and Sidney de Paris battling.

ctx.x: He used to come there and read the newspaper until the band come on or while the show was on, you know; wait and listen to the band, you know. There used to be a bunch of cats used to come in there, used to wear the high-tail collars, and they always used to like stuff bills in my horn, you know. When they'd come in there, we was good for a yard-and-a-half easy.

It was real nice down there. I was offered a job there with me and Sidney de Paris battling. Because you know, when you got a joint like that, when the boss goes away, there's somebody always that's spying on you.
